what: A hovered frame can be captured through scripts/run-game.ps1 at all. Before this change no flag set _hoverCell from outside a live mouse move, so a hovered frame did not exist to hand to the owner; -HoverCell (--hover-cell engine-side) is the missing input.

base.howObtained: git worktree add ../_wt-373-focus-flag -b feature/373-focus-flag origin/main, then git rev-parse HEAD

scene.why: The frame and cell named in Issue #373 itself: two raiders and no crew stand on (16,7) at this tick of this seed.

howMeasured: The engine's own canonical checksum (the field named "checksum" in the printed godot_graybox_screenshot event) is identical between the quiet and the hovered run: hovering never touches PrototypeWorld. The PNG's own sha256 differs (d683154c... vs 4d450dce...), which is the frame actually changing. What changes is which raider captions WorldLabels.Of has room for: hovering (16,7) promotes one of its two raiders to WorldLabelRank.Hovered, which is exactly the label-priority mechanism Issue #371/#364 already ship and test (WorldLabelFocusTests) — --hover-cell only supplies the focus a live pointer would have supplied.

howImplemented.parsing: src/DungeonFortress.Game/Main.cs reads --hover-cell with CommandLineArguments.Read, the same helper --select-cell already used
howImplemented.application: src/DungeonFortress.Game/Main.Player.cs's new ApplyHoverCellArgument sets _hoverCell and reads WorldLabels.PointedAt(_state, cell, CurrentWorldLabelFocus().Selected) — byte-for-byte the same call Main.Player.cs's UpdatePointer already makes for a real mouse move, so a synthetic hover cannot diverge from a live one by construction.

reproducibility.note: Measured together with criterion 2 and 3 on the combined hover+select command; see evidence/373-focus.json's reproduction block for the two-runs-one-sha256 pair.
